cards.title: What wakes Rosie
items: Only a Submit (portal, public link, or an admin marking the AR Completed) wakes Rosie
Saving a line without submitting is acknowledged but never delivered
A re-submit wakes her again; there is no de-duplication

cards.title: Where Chris decides
items: Rosie publishes or emails an AR only after Chris approves that scope
On submit the database changes a pick only to swap an Unavailable one for its substitute
Picking any other candidate needs Chris: a drag in the app or his yes in chat

cards.title: If the harness is down
items: The supplier's answers are already saved before the event is sent
The event is best effort: a miss is logged by the app, never retried
Screens still refresh from the database; Rosie just is not woken
